desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on escalating attacks on commercial shipping in the western Black Sea and a major unexplained fire/explosion at Russia’s Sochi port. The single most important development is the apparent strike on multiple Turkish-owned vessels, including one that sank with crew missing, amid broader Russia-Ukraine naval drone activity.

## MAIN THREADS
### Sochi port fire and ship explosion
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107505623009054869) and [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107498484253511875) both report a large column of black smoke from an apparent ship explosion at the Port of Sochi; local channels cite a vessel ablaze.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107508953328357834) and follow-up videos from the same account show earliest footage of the tanker on fire.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107505623009054869) notes prior Ukrainian strikes on Sochi (Sept 3–7) and links the incident to ongoing attacks on Black Sea shipping.

### Attacks on Turkish grain carriers
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107505623009054869) details the sinking of the Turkish-owned Royad Mammadov off Romania (two crew killed) and hits on two more Turkish vessels off Bulgaria, with the Alfa Watan sunk and crew missing.
- The same post records Zelensky blaming Russia, while Romania and Bulgaria have not assigned blame; von der Leyen highlighted targeting of commercial ships.

### French M51.3 SLBM test
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107520163394597247) reports Macron overseeing the first test launch of the M51.3 from SSBN Le Vigilant after maintenance, noting the timing amid Russia-Europe tensions.

### Trump dyed-diesel executive order
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107508953328357834) covers the EO allowing dyed diesel on public roads and deferring federal tax through 2026, driven by record diesel prices ($6.32–$6.53/gal) since the Iran war began.

### AP investigation into Kuwait port strike
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107501342134804961) summarizes the AP report on the March 1 Iranian drone strike at Port Shuaiba: no mass-casualty evacuation plan was implemented, soldiers used Google for hospitals, and wounded were delayed in Kuwait due to ongoing threats.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107505623009054869) claims the Sochi explosion came from a ship at the port (unconfirmed).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107505623009054869) states the Alfa Watan sank with crew missing after a drone strike 70 nm off Bulgaria (unconfirmed).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107501342134804961) reports the medical officer’s evacuation plan was never briefed after she was sent to Jordan (unconfirmed).  
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107500143717335191) identifies the burning vessel as an oil tanker (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for confirmation of the Sochi ship’s identity and any Ukrainian or Russian claims of responsibility. Further escalation against NATO-flagged or commercial shipping in the Black Sea EEZ is expected next.
